messages:
jess: Heads-up — small auth hotfix targeting Thursday 18:00 PT. No DB changes. Need someone to own the slot, run smoke, and be rollback lead. @here
ryan: I can take the slot and smoke owner. Can cover rollback too if needed.
samir: thanks — quick q: any chance this touches session tokens? need to know which smoke checks to run.
jess: good call. it touches token refresh flow but not schema. smoke should include login, refresh, and keystone auth path.
maya: I'll add a test for refresh in the smoke script, pushing a tiny PR to the smoke-runner.
ryan: awesome. linked runbook and smoke checklist: https://confluence/redwood/deploys/hotfix-runbook. rollback play is just toggle FF + revert image tag.
li: what's the FF name/command? I want to be able to flip quickly if required.
ryan: feature flag is `auth_v2_hotfix`. toggle via `./ops/ffctl toggle auth_v2_hotfix off --env prod` (we'll also have ops on standby).
samir: PR for hotfix merged to main and green CI — cc @jess.
jess: confirmed, saw green. can we get a quick pre-deploy checklist here?
ryan: pre-deploy checklist: 1) confirm smoke PR merged 2) run smoke in staging + prod-preview 3) ensure alerting targets (5xx rate) watch 4) have rollback command ready 5) notify support. I'll run stages at T-30/T-10.
maya: smoke PR merged to runner repo, added refresh test.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy slot reserved: Thu 18:00 PT — owner: ryan — expected duration: 15m.
li: I'll be on-call for rollback toggle window (18:00-18:30).
jess: perfect. ryan can you paste the exact image tag and the revert command you'll use so support knows?
ryan: image tag: `registry.redwood/inference:hotfix-2026-03-17-rc1`. revert: `kubectl set image deploy/auth-service auth=registry.redwood/inference:canary` then toggle FF if necessary.
samir: I'll monitor session-related SLOs and watch traces.
jess: thanks team. i'll post a one-line announcement to #general 10m before, and support ping before + after. :thumbsup:
ryan: got it, will run smoke at T-30 in staging and report here.
li: standing by. good luck :)
